title: Figrin D'an
description: "Fiery" Figrin D'an was the frontman for the Modal Nodes, a band that made waves inside the Mos Eisley Cantina with their most recognizable hit. It didn't matter that Obi-Wan Kenobi ignited a Lightsaber while they were playing, and attacked Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba, they barely skipped a beat. With his trusty Kloo Horn, the Bith rocker was one of the best at what he did, swaying with the tunes and entertaining the crowd with ease.
